description: Named by the control client's id for the team: Central's TEAM-00520, Press's Press Team. One team per id: the tier limits are the team's.

fields.description: Store the prompts and model outputs of this team's keys in the gateway's payload log (short retention, support queries).
fields.label: Log Prompts & Outputs

fields.description: The Tier the team runs under: its key count, monthly spend limit and, for keys with no limits of their own, rate limits. Picked when the team is made in Desk; after that the control client names it (Central from the team's trust tier). Blank is the default tier in Grove Settings.
fields.label: Tier

fields.description: Pin this team's own Max Keys below; unticked, its tier's applies.
fields.label: Override Max Keys

fields.description: How many live keys the team may hold; 0 is no limit.
fields.label: Max Keys

fields.description: The team's keys are refused: pushed as limited on every one, which the gateways refuse whatever its own cap says. Set by Central when the team's invoice goes unpaid, or by Suspend Keys here (Suspended at Grove ticked too). Central's sync cannot lift Grove's hold.
fields.label: Suspended

fields.description: When Central read the tier and standing it last sent (api.teams.team_webhook); a body not newer than this is a retried or reordered delivery and is ignored.
fields.label: Last Reported At

fields.description: What each key's cap counts: this UTC month's spend, reset on the 1st, or everything since the key was minted. Stamped on every key of the team. Set when the team is made and fixed after: the gateway keeps a different counter per window, so a change would restart every key's count. A Total team has no spend limit: its caps are for life, so the month binds nothing; Max Keys and the revokes bound it.
fields.label: Key Cap Window

fields.description: The suspension is Grove's own, from Suspend Keys here: Central's sync cannot lift it. Resume Keys clears both; Central puts Suspended back on its next sync if the invoice is still unpaid.
fields.label: Suspended at Grove

fields.description: What this team's keys may call. A Model Group and a vendor model are one geography's, so each reaches only the team's keys in that geography; a model of ours reaches them everywhere. Deny wins over everything.
fields.label: Model Access

fields.description: Groups this team's keys run under, each reaching the keys of its own geography. A new team starts in every geography's default group.
fields.label: Model Groups

fields.description: Models the team's keys may call on top of their groups'. A vendor model reaches the keys of its geography, a model of ours every key.
fields.label: Allow

fields.description: Models the team's keys may never call. Deny wins over everything — a group grant and a Public release both lose to it.
fields.label: Deny

name: Grove Team
